# ffxf_vm_backup_restore (Resource)

Restores a virtual machine from a backup. WARNING: restoring overwrites the VM disk and replaces its current data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_vm_backup_restore" "example" {
  vm_id  = 123
  backup = "backup-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup` (String) Opaque backup identifier to restore; the current VM disk is overwritten.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.
